newsitem.title: CHINA: DALIAN BEATS SICHUAN IN CHINA SOCCER LEAGUE.
newsitem.headline: DALIAN BEATS SICHUAN IN CHINA SOCCER LEAGUE.

text.p: League champions Dalian Wanda beat Sichuan Quanxin 3-1 in Chengdu in Sichuan province on Sunday to extend its unbeaten streak to 38 games after the fourth round of China's first division soccer league.

After a scoreless first half, Wang Tao opened the scoring for Dalian in the 53rd minute, only to see Sichuan Quanxin tie the score at 1-1 one minute later through a header from Liu Bin, the Xinhua news agency said.
Dalian surged ahead again in the 77th minute when Wang converted a pass from Hao Haidong and sealed the victory in the last minute with a goal from Li Ming.

In other matches, a 10-man Guangzhou Apollo team rallied from behind to overcome Vanguard Huandao 2-1, Tianjin Samsung beat Qingdao Hainiu 1-0, while Jilin Aodong forced a scoreless draw with Guangdong Hongyuan.
Beijing Guoan tied 1-1 with August First and Jinan Taishan drew 1-1 with Shanghai Shenhua.
